content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the case involved the division of matrimonial property and the cancellation of credit agreements the court upheld the applicants request to cancel the credit agreements treating the applicants financial obligations towards the bank as personal commitments however three specific credit agreements will remain the applicants responsibility even after the dissolution of the marriage the case also involved the establishment of asset balance and the protection of creditors rights the parties involved are referred to as ium and d ium filed a lawsuit against d requesting the court to dissolve their marriage exclude maintenance and exclude obligations from a consumer credit agreement the court decided to hear the case immediately after a preparatory hearing the court dismissed the action concluding that the marriage was registered in the civil registry office šiauliai city municipal administration and that there are no real estate properties owned by either party the court then proceeded to divide the property confirming that the parties acquired both immovable and movable property together the court also ruled that the spouses liabilities towards the bank should be canceled treating them as personal obligations the court ordered the party in whose favor the judgment was given to pay the costs of the proceedings including a stamp duty and the costs of the lawyer the costs of sending procedural documents will be charged to the state since the case was conducted electronically the court made a decision upholding the action for the dissolution of the marriage and establishing the obligations of the parties towards a bank regarding consumer credit agreements
